PIN NUMBER RECEIVED!!! My bestfriend @Lorna Villaruz is officially a UK registered nurse!!! 🎉🎉🎉 Thank you Lord!! Lorna, I am so happy I cannot even type properly. After all the papers, exams, prayers and waiting waiting waiting, finally this is YOUR news to celebrate!! Liverpool here you come!! ❤️

For 20 years I have been telling this woman, come here na, come to Liverpool, we will be together again. She probably got tired of hearing me haha. And now she is landing in Manchester on 14 January 2027 and starting work on 25 January, Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital!! It is really happening!! I will have to find something else to nag her about now. The winter coat, probably 😂

From nursing school in Iloilo to this, my friend. Our capping ceremony in 1996, same hairstyle, same dreams, and those white shoes we polished every single night in the dorm. Only some of us actually BOUGHT the polish, ha Lorna?? This one always borrowed mine, never bought her own 😂 Now you have your UK PIN, maybe finally you can repay me one tin of shoe polish. With interest. Thirty years of interest!!

When I left for the UK in 2004, you said at the airport, “Susunod ako.” I will follow you. Well!! Twenty-two years later, here we are celebrating your PIN and getting ready for you to come!! You took the scenic route, my friend, Riyadh then Dubai, almost 18 years working out there, but finally Liverpool is next. Worth all the nagging haha ❤️

And Ward 7, you are so lucky to have her. She is the best nurse I know. So calm, so caring, the patients love her. Even in nursing school I knew I would want someone like Lorna looking after my family. So proud that you will be bringing all those years of experience here, my friend. Your new patients and colleagues have somebody very special coming.

When you were in Nottingham for your OSCE I sent you a photo of the rain, just so nobody can say I did not warn you 😂 Please bring a PROPER coat!! Not a little jacket because it looks nice in the airport photo. Liverpool wind does not care about fashion!!

The spare room is waiting for your first month with us, Ben says yes, and I will make sure there is a thick duvet. You bring yourself and we will sort the rest. After all these years, imagine us having a cup of tea together without checking the time difference first!!

Welcome to our Filipino family here, Lorna. The food, the Christmas parties, all the talking and laughing, and next year Simbang Gabi together with us. So much to look forward to!!

Mga kabayan, help me give my bestfriend a big Liverpool welcome!! Congratulations, my sister from another mother. Finally I can stop saying “when you come” and start saying “see you in January”!!! Love you!! ❤️🎉🙏
